tender.title: TD2431 - For the Provision of a Domestic Abuse Service
tender.description:
Derby City Council is seeking to appoint domestic abuse safe accommodation and support for people experiencing domestic abuse. The Domestic Abuse Safe Accommodation Refuge Service will deliver safe accommodation to people who are fleeing current or recent domestic abuse.
 
Derby City Council are seeking to procure a communal refuge with at least 17 adult bed spaces, alongside a minimum of 8 units of self-contained accommodation (increasing to 12 in year 2), of which 5 should be capable of accommodating families (increasing to 8 in year 2). At least one self-contained unit should be adapted to meet the needs of a wheelchair user. The communal refuge should have a variety of single rooms and family rooms, with a minimum of 15 children's bedspaces. The self-contained accommodation should be a mix of two and three bedroomed properties and should be accessible 24/7. The accommodation should have the ability to flex quickly to meet varying needs and family sizes, thus not preventing any barriers to rapid accessibility.
 
In the communal refuge the shared areas should be designed in consultation with the people who will be using them. They should be fully accessible to people accommodated on site without restrictions, and should offer a variety of uses including, group sessions, opportunities for quiet reflection, and peer to peer support.
 
Further details can be found in Part Three Specification

tender.title: Conversion & Commercial Fit-Out of 90 Hermon Hill E18 to 105-Place Nursery - HW/4699
tender.description:
Happywoods Nursery is seeking an experienced commercial main contractor to undertake the full internal conversion, refurbishment, and fit-out of 90 Hermon Hill, South Woodford, London, E18 1QB, converting a vacant former care home into a 105-place children's day nursery with top-floor administrative offices.
      Scope & Design Specification Summary (per Dovetail Architects Design Brief Rev 0 & Drawings PL-100 to PL-122):
      - Classrooms (Babies, Toddlers & 3-5 Years): Forbo welded non-slip vinyl with matching cap & cove; 3mm plaster skim with Dulux Matt Emulsion; Rockfon Blanka dB35 suspended ceilings (600x600mm grid); veneered fire doors with vision panels, finger guards, closers/back-checks & kick plates; adult/child-height handleless base units, 28mm square-edge worktops (mason's mitre), 400mm WhiteRoc splashbacks & SS 1.5 bowl sinks.
      - WCs & Nappy Change: Forbo welded vinyl; 1200mm WhiteRoc wall panelling; 18mm HPL IPS enclosures & 1100mm cubicles; Armitage Shanks Contour 21 Splash WCs (305/355mm); Franke Wave trough sinks with Avon 21 self-closing taps; Concept Arc 55cm basins; full DDA sanitary packs.
      - First Floor Commercial Kitchen & Laundry: Full-height WhiteRoc wall panelling; handleless units; min. 2 sinks plus hand-rinse basin; 304 food-grade fully welded SS extraction canopy with baffle filters, LED lights & speed-controlled fan; dedicated AC heating/cooling.
      - Stair Cores, Offices & Staff Room: Forbo carpet tiles with 150x18mm single-groove MDF skirting; contrasting stair nosings; dual-height brushed 304 SS handrails; 10mm toughened clear glass balustrades; perimeter dado trunking at 850mm FFL; staff kitchenette with microwave housing & 400mm WhiteRoc splashback.
      - MEP & Security: Central boiler serving Low Surface Temperature (LST) radiators throughout, supplemented by air conditioning units in classrooms, offices & kitchen/laundry; L1 fire alarm & secure video intercom.
      - Acoustic & External Works (per Clear Acoustic Design Report CAD-26116): Continuous 2.0m absorptive acoustic timber boundary fencing (Jackson's Jakoustic or approved equal, min. 15 kg/m2 surface mass with sealed base junctions); acoustic sealing/lining to party wall adjoining 92 Hermon Hill; Falcon Way drop-off & external play surfacing. Contract & Site Terms:
      - Form of Contract: JCT Intermediate Building Contract with Contractor's Design (ICD) or JCT Minor Works with Contractor's Design.
      - Site Possession & DBS Exemption: The property is vacant and unoccupied; full site possession transfers to the Principal Contractor under CDM 2015. Because no children are on site during works, Enhanced DBS clearance is NOT required.

Additional information: Site Access, Logistics & Key Notes for Tendering Contractors:
        
        Accompanied Site Visits: Site inspections at 90 Hermon Hill (E18 1QB) are strictly by prior appointment during the tender period. Contractors are strongly encouraged to inspect existing M&E incoming capacities, structural layouts, party-wall conditions, and external garden levels prior to submitting pricing.
        
        Traffic, Deliveries & Neighbour Amenity: The site sits at the junction of Hermon Hill and Falcon Way, directly adjoining residential properties (including 92 Hermon Hill and Osprey Close). Contractors must factor in a practical Traffic & Logistics Management Plan covering material deliveries, skip positioning, and strict adherence to London Borough of Redbridge permitted construction working hours.
        
        Design Brief & Acoustic Compliance: Tenderers must price strictly in accordance with the attached HappyWoods Design Brief (June 2026, Rev 0) and Clear Acoustic Design Noise Impact Assessment (CAD-26116)-specifically the continuous 2.0m absorptive acoustic timber fencing (minimum 15 kg/m² surface mass with sealed base junctions) and party-wall soundproofing specifications.
        
        Unoccupied Site / DBS Exemption: The building is vacant and unoccupied; full site possession will transfer to the Principal Contractor under CDM Regulations 2015. Enhanced DBS clearance is NOT required for construction operatives.
        
        Clarifications (RFIs): All technical or commercial queries during the tender period must be submitted through this portal's messaging function so anonymized responses can be issued simultaneously to all bidders.
